title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 1:19
body: “What again is "spiritual blessing in the heavenly places?" It is not upon earth, he means, as was the case with the Jews.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “¿Y qué es otra vez "bendición espiritual en lugares celestiales"? Quiere decir que no es sobre la tierra, como sucedía con los judíos.”

title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 43:26
body: “Now to this end God hath opened to us many ways. For, "Tell thou first," saith He, "thy sins, that thou mayest be justified" ( Isa.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Ahora bien, para este fin Dios nos ha abierto muchos caminos. Porque "relata tú", dice Él, "para abonarte" (Is.”

title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 48:11
body: “This he adds in immediate connection. And why? Because it would serve to give those who heard it full assurance.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “Esto lo añade en conexión inmediata. ¿Y por qué? Porque serviría para dar plena certeza a los que lo oyeran.”

title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 52:5
body: “For in what, O most foolish of men, are ye injured by the care bestowed on others? How are your blessings made less through having others to share the same?”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Porque ¿en qué, oh el más necio de los hombres, te perjudica el cuidado puesto en otros? ¿Cómo se hacen menores tus bendiciones por tener a otros que compartan lo mismo?”

title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 53:9
body: “In reality, the people were subject to another curse, which says, "Cursed is every one that continueth not in the things that are written in the book of the Law." (Deut.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “En realidad, el pueblo estaba sujeto a otra maldición, que dice: "Maldito todo aquel que no permaneciere en todas las cosas que están escritas en el libro de la ley, para hacerlas." (Deut.”

title: Athanasius on Isaiah 54:13
body: “In Plato's ideal Republic, the notion of any direct influence of the highest ideals upon the masses is quite absent. Their happiness is to be in passive obedience to the few whom those ideals inspire.”
author: Athanasius, On the Incarnation of the Word
bodyEs: “En la República ideal de Platón está del todo ausente la noción de una influencia directa de los ideales más altos sobre las masas. La felicidad de estas ha de estar en la obediencia pasiva a los pocos a quienes aquellos ideales inspiran.”

title: John Chrysostom on Isaiah 66:2
body: “Knowing therefore this, let us continue steadfastly to hold what "they have delivered unto us, which from the beginning were eye-witnesses, and ministers of the word." ( Luke i.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Sabiendo, pues, esto, sigamos firmes en guardar lo que "nos enseñaron los que desde el principio lo vieron por sus ojos, y fueron ministros de la palabra." (Lc. 1.”
